layouts.name: 商品识别主图
composition_rules: One complete sellable object on white; preserve a readable silhouette and natural material highlights.
Read the product outline first, then actual construction; no illustrative overlays.
layouts.copy_guidance: No added text or promotional graphics; retain actual product markings.

layouts.name: 场景主视觉
composition_rules: Let a credible environment or person/action frame the actual product as the dominant story subject.
Use foreground, subject and background depth; keep one quiet headline region rather than emptying half the canvas.
layouts.copy_guidance: One benefit-led headline when assigned; atmosphere must not obscure the product.

layouts.name: 卖点与视觉证据并置
composition_rules: Pair a strong product/feature visual with a smaller explanation area; use unequal visual weight.
Lead with the actual evidence, then one benefit and its supporting detail.
layouts.copy_guidance: One primary benefit, one short supporting line; icons only if they explain verified information.

layouts.name: 局部特写与整体关联
composition_rules: Use a dominant true surface/component closeup plus one smaller contextual view of the same evidenced product.
Show what the viewer is looking at; control the scale jump and keep inset borders subordinate.
layouts.copy_guidance: Short descriptive label or approved benefit; a texture alone does not prove a performance claim.

layouts.name: 主证据与辅助细节
composition_rules: Give one large proof visual priority and arrange two or three related supporting details in an aligned smaller strip.
The supporting strip must explain the same buyer question, not turn into unrelated feature thumbnails.
layouts.copy_guidance: Keep one headline; use short labels on supporting details only when they add information.

layouts.name: 可验证操作序列
composition_rules: Arrange evidenced start/intermediate/end states in a clear reading sequence, with consistent product scale and orientation.
Use deliberate step spacing and numbering; every contact, movement and arrow must match actual operation evidence.
layouts.copy_guidance: Concise verified step labels; never invent a mechanism to make the design more dynamic.

layouts.name: 尺寸与选择指南
composition_rules: Place the relevant real product measurement view beside a clearly structured selection table or fit labels.
Separate measurement marks from product contours; make the decision path easier to scan than the fine print.
layouts.copy_guidance: Only verified dimensions and compatibility; missing data is a gap, not a decorative substitute.

layouts.name: 真实款式矩阵
composition_rules: Arrange only registered variants in an evenly spaced selection matrix with consistent angle and scale.
Use colour grouping and one anchor product to aid selection; do not invent additional SKUs.
layouts.copy_guidance: Names/labels from registered variants; avoid unsupported best-choice badges.

layouts.name: 有依据的对比
composition_rules: Compare evidenced states or approved own-product options in balanced columns with identical visual scale.
Let one true difference dominate, supported by precise labels rather than invented superiority.
layouts.copy_guidance: Use approved factual wording; no fabricated competitor, ratings or performance data.

layouts.name: 非对称主景与细节
composition_rules: Use one large scene or product view and a narrow secondary detail column, with clearly unequal visual weights.
Align the column and primary subject around a shared baseline; maintain one primary focal point.
layouts.copy_guidance: One short headline; keep each secondary detail tied to the same promise.

layouts.name: 多情境叙事
composition_rules: Divide the image into a dominant lifestyle scene and two subordinate scenes with distinct real use contexts.
Make the person, action and environment recognizable; keep product identity consistent without copying the same wrist crop.
layouts.copy_guidance: Optional short situation labels; do not imply unsupported sports or operating capabilities.

layouts.name: 中心产品与少量注释
composition_rules: Keep an actual product centrally legible and place a few related evidence details around its free perimeter.
Connect labels spatially without crossing product contours or obscuring attachment interfaces.
layouts.copy_guidance: Limit labels to the assigned message; no dense halo of decorative badges.

layouts.name: 文字与产品共同构图
composition_rules: Balance a bold concise approved headline with a full recognizable product silhouette, using scale and alignment for impact.
Typography and product form should share a deliberate axis rather than a generic empty-side layout.
layouts.copy_guidance: Exact concise copy only; type must not overlap important product structure.

layouts.name: 完整人物与环境场景
composition_rules: Show a recognizable person performing a relevant activity in a credible environment; make the worn product readable at natural scale.
Use the activity and gaze/action to guide attention toward the product without resorting to a cropped anonymous wrist.
layouts.copy_guidance: Copy may be absent when the scene tells the assigned story; the approved task decides.

layouts.name: 选择后的生活收束
composition_rules: Use a clear product and a relevant contextual cue to close the visual story with the intended ownership/use feeling.
Lower information density after explanation-heavy images; retain visual continuity without repeating an earlier composition.
layouts.copy_guidance: One restrained approved closing line, or intentional no-copy photography.

stages.single_message: Identify or explain the one explicitly requested task without inventing a multi-image sales funnel.

stages.recognition: Make the actual product recognizable and relevant.
stages.relevance: Show the buyer situation or desired use context.
stages.proof: Explain one supported differentiator with visible/factual proof.
stages.decision: Resolve fit, variants, use or another concrete buying question.

narratives.name: 情境—任务—产品帮助—结果

stages.situation: Establish the real situation and customer task.
stages.solution: Show how the actual product fits that task, using supported claims only.
stages.proof: Give evidence for the specific promised help.
stages.outcome: Show a credible outcome or decision context without invented before/after results.

stages.understand: Introduce the actual product and important material/construction.
stages.verify: Present evidence for a concrete differentiator.
stages.use: Show an evidenced operation or a credible relevant lifestyle.
stages.choose: Help select size/variant or summarize a supported ownership benefit.

constraints: Original product evidence controls identity and supported facts.
Graphic effects cannot establish a product claim.
Boxes are layout starting points, not platform specifications.
